## Preface {.unnumbered}

@{sec-act0-history} is heavily based on @{mathur2022}, @{sec-act0-applications} on @{peres2020}.

```{=html}
<script>
  // Adds a "DOI" entry to the title-block metadata (next to author, affiliation, date).
  window.document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
    const meta = window.document.querySelector(".quarto-title-meta");
    if (meta === null) return;
    const entry = window.document.createElement("div");
    entry.innerHTML =
      '<div class="quarto-title-meta-heading">DOI</div>' +
      '<div class="quarto-title-meta-contents"><p>' +
      '<a href="https://zenodo.org/badge/latestdoi/1368101918">' +
      '<img src="https://zenodo.org/badge/1368101918.svg" alt="DOI"></a>' +
      "</p></div>";
    meta.appendChild(entry);
  });
</script>
```
